live_studio.error_key_in_watch_field: That looks like a stream key, not a watch link. Keep the key secret and paste the public watch link here.
live_studio.error_watch_in_key_field: That is a watch link, not a stream key. Paste it into the watch-link field and copy the key from YouTube Studio.
live_studio.watch_check_not_found: YouTube has no video with that link. Check that you copied the whole watch link.
live_studio.watch_check_ended: That broadcast has already ended on YouTube. Start a new one and paste its link.
live_studio.watch_check_not_live: That is a regular video, not a live broadcast. Paste the link of the broadcast you are streaming.
live_studio.watch_check_wrong_channel: That broadcast belongs to a different YouTube channel than the one on record for this account.
live_studio.watch_check_unverified_note: YouTube could not confirm the link right now, so it was listed unchecked. Make sure it is your live broadcast.
live_studio.find_live_wait: Please wait half a minute before searching again.
live_studio.error_watch_id_required_phone_app: Paste the YouTube watch link or 11-character video ID of the broadcast your phone app is sending.
live_studio.phone_app_listed_live_body: The server accepted video ID {}. The app cannot see your phone app or YouTube ingest. Check that YouTube Studio is receiving your stream.
live_studio.watch_check_channel_unconfirmed_note: No YouTube channel is on record for this account, so the link could not be matched to your channel. Make sure it is yours.
live_studio.watch_check_scheduled_later: That broadcast is scheduled more than an hour from now. List it closer to the start time.
live_studio.error_ingest_in_key_field: That is the server address (rtmp://...), not the stream key. Copy the key itself from YouTube Studio.
live_studio.watch_check_channel_lookup_failed_note: Your channel could not be looked up on YouTube just now, so the link was not matched to it. Make sure it is yours.
live_studio.audio_only_note: Viewers hear you and see no camera picture. A custom backdrop image is not sent to YouTube yet.
live_studio.audio_only_note_encoder: In this app viewers see the audio stage. What YouTube viewers see is decided by your sending app.
live_studio.error_phone_screen_open: The phone broadcast screen is already open. Close this sheet to use it.
live_studio.watch_check_unavailable: YouTube could not verify this watch link. Nothing was listed. Check the API key or connection, then try again.
live_studio.watch_check_channel_required: The watch link could not be matched to your approved channel. Nothing was listed. Check the channel on your application or organization, then try again.

Anyone with the YouTube watch link or the room link can still watch: this is not private. It applies to this broadcast only; a new broadcast is listed normally. You can show it again at any time.

broadcast_ended.title: Broadcast ended
broadcast_ended.admin_end: An administrator ended this broadcast in the app. This phone has stopped sending. Your broadcaster approval and this device's broadcasting role are unchanged, so you can start a new broadcast.
broadcast_ended.admin_remove: An administrator ended this broadcast and blocked its watch link from being listed in the app again. This phone has stopped sending. To go live, create a new broadcast in YouTube Studio and use its new watch link.
broadcast_ended.stale_expired: The broadcast was ended because this device stopped reaching the server. Check your connection, then start again.
broadcast_ended.replaced: Another broadcast on your account replaced this one. This phone has stopped sending.
broadcast_ended.generic: This broadcast was ended outside this device. This phone has stopped sending.
broadcast_ended.ingest_lost: This phone could not reconnect to YouTube for two minutes, so the broadcast was ended in the app. Check your connection, then start a new broadcast.
broadcast_ended.organization_revoked: An administrator revoked the organization's verification, so its broadcast ended. Your personal broadcaster approval is unchanged.

auth_refusal.title: No new account was created
auth_refusal.signups_paused: New sign-ups are paused right now, so this Google account could not create an account. If you already have an account, sign in with the Google account you used before.
auth_refusal.generic: Google sign-in was refused, so you were not signed in with that account. Try again, or use another account.
auth_refusal.still_signed_in: You are still signed in as {account}. That account was not changed.

broadcast_watch_link_blocked: An administrator blocked this watch link from being listed in the app. Your broadcaster approval is unchanged. Create a new broadcast in YouTube Studio and use its new watch link.

live_guide.watch_help: In YouTube Studio, open the broadcast you will use. Select Share (the arrow shown above), then copy its public watch link and paste it into YouTube Live Link. Use the link for the same broadcast as your stream key.
live_guide.key_help: In the same broadcast, open Stream settings. Beside the stream key, press Copy (shown above), then paste it into YouTube Stream Key. Keep it secret: never send it to viewers or paste it into the live-link field.
live_guide.watch_image: YouTube Studio Share button for the public watch link
live_guide.key_image: YouTube Studio Copy button beside the hidden stream key
live_guide.obs_1: OBS Studio on your computer sends the camera and microphone to YouTube. This app does not run OBS and cannot see it.
live_guide.obs_2: In YouTube Studio open Go live > Stream. Copy the stream URL and stream key into OBS under Settings > Stream.
live_guide.obs_3: Start streaming in OBS. Then copy the watch link from YouTube Studio (Share) and paste it here.
live_guide.obs_4: The app checks the link with YouTube and lists you as live. When you finish, end the broadcast here and stop streaming in OBS.
live_guide.phone_app_1: A separate streaming app on a phone (for example Larix Broadcaster) sends the video to YouTube. We have not tested any specific app. Check its free-use limits before a long broadcast.
live_guide.phone_app_2: Put the stream URL and stream key from YouTube Studio (Go live > Stream) into that app, and start sending.
live_guide.phone_app_3: Paste the watch link here. Do not use this app's Phone camera at the same time.
live_guide.phone_app_4: When you finish, end the broadcast here and stop sending in the other app.
live_guide.phone_1: This phone sends its own camera and microphone to YouTube.
live_guide.phone_2: Paste the stream key (YouTube Studio > Go live > Stream) and the watch link of the same broadcast, then Open Camera.
live_guide.phone_3: Keep this screen open while you broadcast. Broadcasting in the background is not available yet, so leaving the screen ends the broadcast. Use End broadcast to stop.
live_guide.phone_4: Audio only: viewers hear you and see no camera picture. The camera stays on in this phone. Turning the phone does not rotate the picture viewers see.
live_guide.local_1: Streaming to devices on the same Wi-Fi without the internet is not available in this version.
live_guide.local_2: It needs a local video connection between the apps that has not been built or tested yet. Nothing in this mode is saved or sent.
live_guide.local_3: To go live now, use Phone or Encoder.
live_guide.link_vs_key_body: The watch link is public: viewers use it. The stream key is secret: only the sending app uses it, and anyone with it can send to your channel. Never paste the key into the watch-link field or share it.

roster.import_note: Names are imported as cards. Send each preacher a link when you are ready.
roster.empty_body: Add a preacher or import a list.
roster.photo_hint: An https link to his photo (optional).

mosques.merged: Lessons moved and the mosque removed
mosques.pin: Tap the map to place it
mosques.in_use: Lessons use this mosque. Choose the mosque to move them to.
mosques.body: The mosques admins choose for lessons. Hidden ones are kept out of the public calendar and map.
mosques.remove_body: No lessons use it. It is removed from the directory and the map.

stats.monthly: Monthly report for the ministry branch
stats.attendance_note: Attendance comes from preachers' after-lesson reports.
stats.csv_note: The copy is Excel-safe: cells starting with = + - or @ are neutralized.

auditlog.note: Every lessons action is recorded: who, when and on what. The log is read-only.

admin.title: Preachers & lessons
admin.reports_body: Viewers tell you when a time or place is wrong. Fix the lesson, then mark the report resolved.
admin.locked_body: Admins, master admins and lessons admins manage preachers and lessons.

approvals.body: Preachers send requests and card changes through their links. Nothing becomes public until you approve it.
approvals.choose_mosque: Choose a mosque for each request before approving.
approvals.no_requests_body: Requests preachers send from their links appear here.

preacher_admin.title: Preacher
preacher_admin.form_note: You can fill in everything yourself. The preacher can also suggest changes from his link; you approve them.
preacher_admin.listed: Show his card to the public
preacher_admin.listed_desc: When off, his card and lessons are only in this area.
preacher_admin.name_needed: Write the full name (at least three letters).
preacher_admin.photo_https: The photo link must start with https://
preacher_admin.account_body: Only for a preacher who also streams: link his account so his channel shows on his card. Preachers do not need an account.
preacher_admin.search_account: Search by name or email, then press Enter
preacher_admin.remove_body: His card, his links and {} are removed for good. This cannot be undone.

links.title: His links
links.body: A link opens his own page without an account: he sees his lessons, asks for new ones and suggests changes to his card. You approve everything.
links.none_yet: No link yet. You can manage everything without one.
links.once_desc: The first phone that opens it keeps it. It works on that phone only, until you revoke it.
links.window_desc: Works on any phone, from a start to an end that you choose.
links.bad_dates: Check the dates: the end must be in the future and after the start.
links.only_now: This is the only time the link is shown. Copy it or send it now.
links.msg_once: Open it on your phone. It works on that phone only.
links.msg_once_until: Open it on your phone. It works on that phone only, until {}.
links.revoked: Link revoked. It no longer opens.

link.this_phone: This link works on this phone only.
link.this_phone_until: This link works on this phone only, until {}.
link.request_sub: The admins approve it and choose the mosque.
link.edit_sub: Your changes show after the admins approve them.
link.edit_waiting: Your change is waiting for the admins.
link.mosque_later: The admins will choose the mosque
link.note_hint: For example: the mosque you prefer
link.mosque_note: You do not need to choose a mosque. The admins choose it when they approve.
link.title_needed: Write the title of the lesson.
link.sent: Your request was sent. The admins will review it.
link.bio_hint: A few lines about your lessons
link.edit_note: The admins review your changes before anyone sees them.
link.edit_sent: Sent to the admins for approval.
link.footer: Your mobile number is never shown to the public. If this link stops working, ask the admins for a new one.
link.closed_revoked: This link does not work any more
link.closed_body_revoked: Ask the admins for a new link.
link.closed_not_yet: This link has not started yet
link.closed_body_not_yet: Open it again at the time the admins told you.
link.closed_body_expired: Ask the admins for a new link.
link.closed_used: This link is open on another phone
link.closed_body_used: A one-time link works on one phone. Ask the admins for a new link for this phone.
link.closed_offline: We could not reach the server
link.closed_body_offline: Check the internet and try again.
link.my_page_hint: Opened from your link on this device

add.title: Add a lesson
add.preacher_hint: Any preacher in the list. He does not need an account.
add.new_mosque_note: It is added to the directory and the map.
add.past_note: A past date records a lesson that was already held.
add.preview_note: This is how the lesson card looks to the public.
add.published: Published. It is on the calendar and the map.
